recipes.title: Chicken-Crust Spinach & Cheese Calzone
steps: Spread the ground chicken thinly over a parchment-lined tray with a fork or spoon. Season with salt, pepper, onion powder, garlic powder and Italian seasoning.
Blend the cottage cheese until smooth.
Sauté the garlic in the oil, add the spinach and wilt. Stir in the blended cottage cheese, a squeeze of lemon and salt.
Spread the filling over one half of the chicken base, then use the parchment to fold the other half over.
Top with Parmesan and bake at 200 °C (400 °F) for 20–30 minutes, until golden and 74 °C (165 °F) inside. Oven or air fryer both work.
Warm the tomato sauce for dipping.
